title: Digital Transformation Consulting
description: I help you find the two or three places where technology actually changes your numbers, and say plainly which of the other twenty it won't. Usually that means looking hard at where people fall out of your funnel, and why — the answer is more often a confusing page than a missing feature. You get direction you can act on this quarter.

faq.q: What does a product consultation involve?
faq.a: We start with your current bottlenecks and what users are actually doing. From there we shape a practical product direction and sequence the work by what moves numbers first.

faq.q: How long does an engagement typically take?
faq.a: Anywhere from a 2-week focused assessment to a 3-month roadmap-and-advisory engagement, depending on scale.

faq.q: Do we need custom AI or model training?
faq.a: Almost never. Most business value comes from simple workflow integration and off-the-shelf APIs. Part of my job is telling you when the boring solution is the right one.
